🚨🗣️ @RogerTorello: “Frenkie de Jong delivered an excellent performance. With limited defensive options available, the Dutchman once again stepped up to play at centre-back. He passed the test with FLYING colours. After the match, Flick was among the first to congratulate him, embracing the midfielder in a heartfelt hug. The Dutch international, who had also returned from national team duty carrying a minor fitness concern, provided excellent ball progression against Villarreal’s pressing.” #fcblive 🇳🇱

🚨🗣️ @RogerTorello: “Gerard Martín not only contributed directly to the comeback with a spectacular header from a perfectly delivered cross by Pedri on the left, but also produced an outstanding second-half defensive performance. In fact, Martín prevented Villarreal from scoring a third goal after Barça had already done the hardest part by taking a 3-2 lead. Pépé was charging straight towards Joan García’s goal, but Martín made a perfectly timed intervention to win the ball. He celebrated the tackle passionately, with the crowd responding enthusiastically.” #fcblive 🇪🇸
